title: "Chua System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y-x+(|x+1|-|x-1|)\\
\dot{y} &=& x+z\\
\dot{z} &=& ay
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-3.5$ and initial condition $(3,1,-7)$.
